en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard view of a small town main street lined with two‑story buildings and large trees. People, including children and adults, stand and walk along the unpaved road, and a horse-drawn wagon is visible. The architecture is typical of early 20th‑century central Europe. Printed red text at the top left identifies the place, and publisher information appears at the bottom left.
